# Model 1 MultiPCM

`multipcm.h` and `multipcm.cpp` are from [daytona-arcade-recomp](https://github.com/alphanu1/daytona-arcade-recomp/tree/de1fc57448b1165864a1000241414aca244d7a80/src/runtime) at commit `de1fc57448b1165864a1000241414aca244d7a80`, with the include path adjusted. They port Miguel Angel Horna's MAME MultiPCM implementation. The BSD 3-Clause notice for the standalone port is in [LICENSE](LICENSE).
